label: Power-law threshold shift
subgoals: Take the ratio of the later time to the reference time
Raise it to the power-law exponent
Multiply the reference shift by the factor

label: Time to a shift limit
subgoals: Divide the limit by the reference shift
Raise the ratio to one over the exponent
Multiply by the reference time and convert to years

label: Delay guard bands
subgoals: Compute the gate overdrive before and after the shift
Raise the ratio to the alpha exponent
Express the increase as a timing guard band
